description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Frequency once per day

Limited, one-directional communication toward your patron — you can ask; it rarely answers in words.

Put a single question to your patron. You receive no words. The GM instead gives you one of: a sensation, an image, a direction, or nothing at all — and 'nothing at all' is a real answer that the feat does not protect you from. You may not ask the same question twice in a day.
